Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Clavier : chiffres pour remplir, Maj + c: Keyboard: numbers to fill, Shift + number (or N) for notes, arrows to move, Backspace to erase, Ctrl + Z to cancel. The current grid is kept.
Des grilles générées à la volée et toujo: Grids generated on the fly and always with a single solution, in five levels, from Easy (40 digits given) to Diabolical (21). Pencil notes that clean themselves up, highlighting of related cells, undo, hints, mistakes shown or hidden, full keyboard play; best time per level and the game in progress kept.
Meilleurs temps, grilles finies et parti: Best times, finished grids and the game in progress.
